detail: Within-patch normalized-pixel differences; both pixel footprints wholly inside original image; average valid differences separately per direction; zero if none.
nonpad: Sort by padding fraction ascending with seeded random tie order; fully nonpadding first, then least-padded fallback.
merge: Cosine nearest of ALL kept targets, ascending position order; average own vector plus all assigned sources. Input fp16, decoder fp32 then cast. No proportional attention.
stage2: Recompute E on current states; detail/padding inherited from target original position. Drop/merge may differ in stage2 E membership.
interpretation: Whole-pipeline selector comparisons; no isolated causal mediation; detail versus nonpad does not by itself remove all padding confounding.
calibration: First5 frozen TextVQA manifest questions; no outcome filtering;31 conditions;155 primary predictions.
references: Fresh uncompressed/native and5 pure-random-drop seeds. Archived reference comparisons record drift, never answer-based retries.
